svg.aria-label: Worked example from the paper: an output with 4 mistakes gets a Structure Score of 57.8.
svg.title: Worked example from the paper: an output with 4 mistakes gets a Structure Score of 57.8.
svg.text: Colours show each record's leaf in the source.
Folder names and the order of folders do not matter.
Leaf a2 is filed under parent B.
Leaf a3 sits alone in a new parent D.
Leaves c1 and c2 are merged.
Record z2 moves into the merged leaf.
Its relations conflict at both levels.
Parent precision also counts the 48 triples that the output pairs up
although their records sit in 3 different parents in the source.
4 extra single-child folders (A, b1, C and D) among 10 folders
